title: 第25章 大客户第26章 一拳打爆
slug: 亿倍返还双手插兜没有对手
lines: 苏长歌猛的大喜。
看来来了个大客户，自己打包出售，这就方便太多了！
可就在这时，他忽然察觉到那汉子眼神好像有点不对。
这是个粗犷大汉，身高足足九尺，比在场所有人都高出一个头来，给人极强的压迫感。
他虽然话说的大方利落，但眼中的贪婪是藏不住的。
不过生意上门，苏长歌自然不会管他那么多，可能这大汉是真的很喜欢这些东西吧。
“你要打包，那就给你便宜一点吧，总共7本拳法，1本刀法，8件黄级普兵，收你一千八百块上品灵石吧！”
《撼山拳》最值钱，其他几本功法次之，普兵倒不值几个钱，所以苏长歌也没多要。
“一千八百块？”
大汉冷声道：“有点多了！”
苏长歌眉头一皱，他卖的并不贵，7本拳法1本刀法，这样折合下来相当于一本才收两百多块，8件普兵相当于白送了。
就这，也多？
他淡淡道：“那就再给你少点，一千七百五十块。”
足足少了五十块灵石，不过打包出售可以省下很多时间，苏长歌也懒得坚持己见。
“还是多！”
大汉道。
苏长歌眉毛一挑，也不废话，道：“一千七。”
“还是太多了！”
大汉还是摇头。
“那就一千六吧！”
苏长歌为了省事，再退一步。
没想到那大汉沉声道：“还是高，远超我的预期！”
苏长歌眼眸一凝，旋即问道：“那你想多少？”
不料大汉取出一块色泽暗淡的下品灵石递了过来，冷笑道：“我的预算，只有这么一块！”
四周一下子哗然。
很多人都明白了怎么回事。
不过看这大汉的样子，似乎并不是要抢。
人家苏长歌连太玄道宗的人都杀了，会怕他？
那他来这一出是要做什么？
很多人百思不得其解。
苏长歌看着这区区一块下品灵石，当场就被气笑了。
这是干什么，太岁头上动土？
content_en:
Su Changge was overjoyed.
It seems that a big customer has come and packaged and sold by himself, which is very convenient!
But at this moment, he suddenly noticed something was wrong in the man's eyes.
This was a rugged man, nine feet tall, a head taller than everyone present, giving people a strong sense of oppression.
Although he spoke generously and neatly, the greed in his eyes could not be hidden.
But when business comes to him, Su Changge will naturally not care about him so much. Maybe this big man really likes these things.
"If you want to pack it up, I'll give you a cheaper price. There are a total of 7 boxing books, 1 sword skill, and 8 yellow-level common soldiers. I'll charge you 1,800 high-grade spiritual stones!"
"Mountain Shaking Fist" was the most valuable, followed by the other martial arts books, and "Pu Bing" was not worth much, so Su Changge didn't ask for much.
"Eighteen hundred dollars?"
The big man said coldly: "It's a bit too much!"
Su Changge frowned. What he sold was not expensive. There were 7 books on boxing and 1 book on swordsmanship. This equivalent to a price of more than 200 yuan per book. 8 pieces of common soldiers were equivalent to giving away for free.
That's it, that's a lot?
He said calmly: "Then I'll give you less, one thousand, seven hundred and fifty yuan."
A full fifty pieces of spiritual stones were missing, but selling them in packages could save a lot of time, and Su Changge was too lazy to stick to his own opinion.
"It's still a lot!"
The big man said.
Su Changge raised his eyebrows and said without any nonsense, "One thousand and seven."
"It's still too much!"
The big man still shook his head.
"Then one thousand six!"
Su Changge took another step back to save trouble.
Unexpectedly, the big man said solemnly: "It's still taller, far beyond my expectations!"
Su Changge's eyes narrowed and he immediately asked: "Then how much do you want?"
Unexpectedly, the big man took out a low-grade spiritual stone with a dull color and handed it over, and sneered: "This is the only amount I have in my budget!"
"Wow!"
There was an uproar all around.
Many people figured out what was going on.
But from the look of this big man, he didn't seem to be trying to rob him.
Su Changge even killed people from Taixuan Dao Sect, so would he be afraid of him?
So what is he doing here?
Many people are puzzled.
Su Changge looked at this mere piece of low-grade spiritual stone and laughed angrily on the spot.
What are you doing, making trouble with Tai Sui?
